plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Psychology (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Psychology Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Psychology (Campus)', last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints Total Credits, B.S. Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly (8 semesters of 15), while the B.A. total is printed as 120-124 because the 16 credits of foreign language are expressly not included in the map. The catalog program page lists a Psychology Curriculum of 42 credits (Core 16, Methods 8, Breadth 18); map rows printed without specific course codes (Methods, Breadth, Capstone and elective rows) are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes, transcribed with the map's own labels.
